bundle.title: Rank tender bids with a written reason for each

bids.approach_md:
Ship a TypeScript CLI in src/rank.ts and src/cli.ts.

1. Parse the bundle, bids and records from one JSON file.
2. Score price against the ceiling, technical compliance, delivery time and experience.
3. Emit ranked JSON plus a table, with one written reason per bid.

Acceptance: every test in test/rank.test.ts runs with npm test, and the formula is documented in README.md. Out of scope: any network call or LLM at runtime.
I will write a small scorer quickly and keep it simple. Delivery is fast and the price is the lowest in this tender, so the buyer saves money.

1. Write src/rank.ts as a pure function.
2. Write src/format.ts for the table.
3. Cover ties, missing fields and extreme prices in test/rank.test.ts.

Scope: deterministic scoring only, no clock and no network.

Port an existing scorer from a previous tender.

1. Reuse the ranking core.
2. Add a table renderer.
3. Add tests for the acceptance rules.

Definition of done: npm test is green and the formula is documented.
Fast delivery with a working CLI and tests for the main path.
